scenes.headline: How a robot keeps a distance field for planning
scenes.sub: OREN: an octree prior plus a small neural residual, non-truncated.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Peregrine! Let's see how Oren maps the distance to every surface, continuously, and in real time.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: An explicit octree prior does the heavy lifting, so only a tiny neural residual is left to learn — a full Euclidean distance field, in real time.
scenes.say: The octree carries the structure, so the network only learns a small correction. That keeps it fast, and keeps the distance field accurate everywhere.

scenes.title: Octree prior, plus a small residual

steps.say: A sensor streams in points. Oren drops them into a semi-sparse octree and stores a distance and a gradient at every corner.
Interpolating those corners, with the gradients, gives an explicit distance prior that is accurate even far from any surface.
The same corners also hold a few tiny learned features.
A small network, just two narrow layers, reads a feature together with the prior.
It adds a small residual. Prior plus residual is the final distance, continuous and never truncated.
Because the octree holds the structure, the network stays small and does not forget the scene.

left.title: Truncated SDF
left.say: The usual truncated map only knows distances right next to a surface.

right.title: Euclidean, OREN
right.say: Oren keeps the true distance everywhere, so a planner can read its clearance in the open.

scenes.title: Distance error, Replica room 0
scenes.note: mean absolute SDF error, whole scene
scenes.say: Across the whole room, Oren's mean distance error is two point one five centimetres. Both baselines are worse.

scenes.label: fastest of five, Newer College
scenes.note: on 1.59 GB of graphics memory, the lowest
scenes.say: On the large outdoor sequence it runs at over fourteen frames a second, the fastest tested, on about one and a half gigabytes.

steps.say: Here are the distance fields as a slice. Oren fills the whole room, matching the ground truth.
The truncated methods only colour a thin band near surfaces, and leave the open space blank.

scenes.text: A good explicit prior leaves the network almost nothing to learn.

recap: The structure keeps the network small
scenes.say: Octree prior, tiny residual, a full distance field in real time. That's Oren.
